info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Chervil Notebook Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Chervil Notebook Details Management API allows users to efficiently submit essential details for the catalog of Chervil Notebooks. This endpoint is vital for businesses looking to enhance their product catalog and streamline inventory management. Common consumers include e-commerce platforms, inventory systems, and product management teams seeking to maintain accurate product information. The API supports the creation of new notebook detail entries, ensuring that users can keep their catalogs up-to-date and reflective of current offerings.

post.summary: Create details for a chervil notebook.
post.description: This operation allows users to create and add detailed information to a chervil notebook. It requires the necessary data for the notebook's details and responds with the newly created details object.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for a chervil notebook. The JSON format allows for structured data to be sent in the request, enabling seamless processing of the provided information.

CreateCatalogChervilNotebookDetailReques.title: Chervil Notebook Creation Request

chervil_notebook_id.description: The unique identifier for the Chervil notebook.

requestedBy.description: The name or identifier of the user making the request.

quantity.description: The quantity of Chervil notebooks being requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Chervil notebook.

dimensions.description: The dimensions of the Chervil notebook.

CreateCatalogChervilNotebookDetailReques.description: Schema representing the request body for creating a new Chervil notebook.
